name: Accountsos
description: AI-native UK accounting for limited companies and sole traders. Track transactions, manage VAT, monitor HMRC deadlines, log expenses, and handle invoices through natural language. Auto-fires UK tax knowledge skills (Corporation Tax, VAT, MTD, BADR, capital allowances) verified for the 2026/27 tax year. Pairs with your AccountsOS account via API key — connects to your live books so Claude can read balances, create transactions, check deadlines and answer UK tax questions with gov.uk source citations.
longDescription:
Ships **4 skills**, **6 commands** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (4): `expense-categories` (What UK businesses can and cannot claim as tax-deductible expenses), `tax-deadlines` (UK filing dates, penalties, and compliance calendar for limited companies and sole traders), `uk-accounting` (Core UK limited company accounting knowledge), `vat-rules` (UK VAT registration, rates, schemes, and Making Tax Digital rules)
- **Commands** (6): `categorize` (Bulk review and categorize uncategorized transactions), `deadlines` (Overview of all filing deadlines with penalty warnings and countdown), `invoices` (Review outstanding and overdue invoices with chase suggestions), `log-expense` (Quick expense logging with automatic categorization), `vat-check` (Check quarterly VAT position, outstanding amounts, and filing readiness), `weekly-check` (Full weekly financial review — balance, transactions, deadlines, VAT position, invoices, and DLA)
- **MCP servers** (1): `accountsos`

Installs with `claude plugin install accountsos@claude-community` from `paulgosnell/accountsos-cowork-plugin`.
